description.narrative: The Program Development Objective is to improve financial and technical performance of the electricity distribution companies.

The development objective of Distribution Sector Recovery Program for Nigeria is to improve financial and technical performance of the electricity distribution companies. The Coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic and the oil price collapse are likely to lead Nigeria to its deepest recession in four decades. . In order to the turn-around the Nigerian power sector the Federal Government of Nigeria (FGN) is committed to the implementation of the Power Sector Recovery Program (PSRP) framework which addresses the key pillars of sector performance: (Pillar I) policy and regulatory environment; (Pillar II) network infrastructure; (Pillar III) operational efficiency; and (Pillar IV) financial sustainability. The Distribution Sector Recover Program for Result (DISREP PforR) component will provide funds to the early stages of Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) implementation to improve Distribution Company (DISCOs) technical and financial performance, eventually enabling them to raise the private financing required to fully realize their PIP targets.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I, A, 1.2, (a): The Borrower shall, no later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, establish andthereafter maintain throughout the implementation of the Operation, a Technical Committee (“TC”) with functions, composition andresources satisfactory to the Bank.

Schedule 2, Section I, D, 2, (a): No later than ninety (90) days after the Effective Date, the Borrower shall cause BPE to: (i)recruit a professional firm or firms to act as an independent verification agency or agencies, as the case may be, under terms ofreference(s) satisfactory to the Bank (“Independent Verification Agent(s)” or “IVA(s)”), to be responsible for preparing andproviding verifications reports in accordance with the Verification Protocol, certifying the achievement of those DLIs indicated tobe verified by such independent verification agency or agencies in the Verification Protocol during each Assessment Period; and(ii) furnish the verification reports to the Bank in such scope and in such details as the Bank shall request.

Schedule 2, Section I, E, 1, (b): The Borrower shall cause TCN to furnish to the Bank, as soon as available, but in any case notlater than November 30 of each year, the annual work plan and budget referred to in paragraph 1 above, for their review andapproval; except for the annual work plan and budget for the Project for the first year of Project implementation, which shall befurnished no later than one month after the Effective Date.
